title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream — Episode3 But They're Always Here

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Event Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
That was really fun! We got so much done today!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we did. Also...
I believe we were able to make such strides because of you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks for teaching us those tricks for improving our articulation and body language.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! Anytime!
I was simply sharing the fruits of my labors with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But is it okay for you to teach us this stuff? I mean, we're not actually in that workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
We were even told to teach others these techniques since the goal of the workshop is to make the world of theatre a better place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that's very generous.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu?
You seem anxious. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? No, nothing's wrong...!
I was just replaying what we just did in my head because you guys were so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, we did so much during practice that I'm starting to get really hungry.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, wanna go to our usual diner?
Honami told me that they just added some seasonal parfaits that are really yummy☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really?
I'm kinda hungry too, so that might be nice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Seasonal parfaits?
Actually, I think Saki mentioned the same thing. I've been meaning to try it, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you have a prior engagement?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, we're supposed to put on some one-man performances tomorrow and I need to practice mine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay... That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, you won't be able to come today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry, but you'll have to enjoy those parfaits without me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...
Good luck, Tsukasa!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, these are all their new parfaits?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
Tsukasa was clearly excited about that workshop, but now he's there and not here, I don't feel quite right.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But why? I've been rooting for him this entire time, haven't I...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, everything's fine!
I think I'm a little sleepy because we did so much during practice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you're right! There are so many different kinds of parfaits! Do you know what you're gonna get, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me...? I was thinking about getting this lemon one. I don't see this flavor much and it looks really refreshing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's so you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm gonna get the strawberry one!
It's so cute how the ice cream's shaped like stars☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is really cute.
I was actually having trouble deciding between these two.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, you can have some of mine!
In return, I want some of yours, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you getting, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The 100% beef Salisbury steak.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you're not getting a parfait?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was going to, but I started craving something that wasn't sweet after going through the menu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then I'll take those veggies for you like I always do!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you're getting a parfait. Isn't that gonna taste weird? Well, I guess whatever makes you both happy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, let's hit the bell since we all know what we're getting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna press it!
Ding! Ding! Ding♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're shouting louder than it...

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Here you go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
The star ice cream on mine's really cute, but so is yours, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And your Salisbury steak looks so good, Rui! Is it just me or is it bigger than usual...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems that they made some minor changes to the menu. Unfortunately, that also appears to have led to an increase in vegetables that I'd rather not eat...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's okay! Tsukasa and I'll gobble them all up! But he doesn't like bell peppers, so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right. Tsukasa isn't here today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel...
It is rare for him to be absent.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, even though he's not here, it feels like he is. Talk about having a strong presence...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But didn't this happen once before when Tsukasa said he wanted to practice on his own?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, for “A Pianist Named Thorpe”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought I asked too much of him that time, but it seems that he's been trying even harder recently...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. He's even figured out a way to practice for both the Wonder Stage and his workshop like he said he would.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like he's been able to absorb everything he's learned and grow so much from it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It really is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But seeing how he's been doing recently made me want to not fall behind.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm scared of working with people I don't know, but learning new skills and techniques sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I kinda want to try attending one of those workshops.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I think that's a good choice if it'll help make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may not be able to gather together as much as we used to with Tsukasa gone and you soon-to-be, Nene. It's going to feel a little lonely without you two.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Lonely...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wait, this feeling... Am I...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Feeling lonely...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I knew we'd eventually end up going our separate ways when we were stranded on that desert island.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(I knew all that...
But I thought it was really far into the future.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They're all thinking about their futures already.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Not just Tsukasa.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Nene and Rui too...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We might have to split up sooner than I was expecting...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, in order for them to pursue their dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What are you spacing out for?
Your ice cream's has melted so much it's dripping onto the plate.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
O-Oh no! You're right!
It even got on my clothes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Here, use this towel. It's gonna stain if you don't get it off right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank you so much, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's the conundrum with parfaits.
If you don't eat it quickly, they start melting on you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your stars seem to be no exception.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
My stars...
